releases.displayName: Meet the Locals Content Update - Coming in December!

notes.title: This December, we're bringing a major content update to Outbound!

items.text: We've heard your feedback, and our entire team has been working hard to bring some of the most exciting additions from our roadmap to life!

With the Meet the Locals content update, we're introducing 36 unique characters to the world of Outbound! Each character has their own personality and a unique backstory that connects them to the lives of others.

Many of these locals have their own challenges, stories, and problems that you can help them with. Get to know them, uncover their stories, and lend a hand with their tasks. Who knows? They might even reward you with a useful goodie or two along the way! Discover 45 exciting new tasks to complete, unlock 16 new building blueprints, and earn 4 new material and recipe rewards along the way!
36 unique characters with their own personalities, stories, and tasks scattered throughout the world.
45 exciting new tasks to complete.
16 new building blueprints to discover.
4 new materials and recipes to discover.
Recurring characters with evolving stories that unfold as you progress.
Hikers and fellow campers.
A journal entry for every character you meet.
And much more!

Please note that the update is fully compatible with your save files and you can dive right into the new content! Of course, you can also start a fresh save and experience the world of Outbound like never before, now more lively and full of stories to discover! See you in December!
Patch 1.2.3 just went online!
Bug fixes
Fixed a networking issue when a friend is connecting after the host just transitioned between biomes, due to an old bird spot still being in memory.
Fixed a networking issue when a 3rd friend is connecting after the host and another player have gone sleeping in a tent.

Balancing

The Wildlife Update brings a brand-new way to document your off-grid journey. You can now discover an expanded fauna ecosystem featuring 34 unique animal species roaming across the Outbound's four distinct biomes.

Visit the new Wildlife Outpost in the first biome to download the blueprint for a craftable camera. Fine-tune your shots with professional settings, including Exposure/Brightness, Depth of Field focus points, Saturation, Contrast, and Zoom. Every photo is saved directly to your Steam library and to your hard drive.
The camera automatically detects animals in view. Framing a species and taking a crisp shot logs the animal as 'collected' in a brand-new tab in your personal journal.
The static binoculars found across the world can now be used to view long-distance when you don’t have your camera to zoom in just yet.

A new wooden foundation is added, which has a closed wood floor instead of slats. This is immediately available in the build menu; No new blueprint needed. Based on community feedback, the fishing interaction prompt now only appears while standing still, keeping your HUD clean and uninterrupted while exploring and walking in the water. Also, we added two more rear-view mirror Charms!
A lively world, full of wild animals, birds, and insects (34 species in total)!
A camera with lots of customization options: Saturation, brightness, contrast, and depth of field.
Taking photos and saving them on your computer and in Steam.
All wildlife is detected in camera view. When an animal is sufficiently in view and a picture is taken, this animal is noted down in a new tab in your journal as 'collected'.
An outpost was added in the first biome, in which you can download the blueprint for a craftable camera.
The static binoculars that were already in the game can be looked through. After crafting the camera, they can also be used to take pictures.
A new wooden foundation is added, which has a closed wood floor instead of slats. This is immediately available in the build menu; No new blueprint needed.
The fishing interaction is now only shown while standing still. Having it shown while walking/running was getting in the way.
A new Cap 'n Snap machine is added with 2 rear-view mirror charms and two cute planters in the form of wildlife.

Please note that we are constantly improving Outbound, and there's much more to come. We will continue releasing smaller patches with bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements between major content updates. The next major update will bring even more life to the game, with interactable townsfolk who have their own tasks, quests, and routines!

notes.title: To celebrate the update, Outbound is now 20% off on Steam!

items.text: We hope you're enjoying the additions and improvements we've been bringing to Outbound. Thank you for playing and for being part of this amazing journey! :) If you haven't already, consider leaving a Steam review! ❤️
Patch 1.1.8 just went online!
Multiplayer: Fixed empty Download Terminals. Sometimes the last Signal Tower in a biome did not contain any downloads, which resulted in an empty UI.
Multiplayer: Some minor stability fixes.
Controllers: Improved Dog Companion Radial controls (smoother selection).
Controllers: Added a missing dead zone for a stick.
Patch 1.1.7 is now live!
Fixed an issue where the progression of players who joined friends' games was not saved properly in some cases.
Added a direction indicator to the dog companion radial menu when using a controller.

We were able to track down and fix a very important bug with this patch. Many of you reported losing your progression while playing with friends. Thanks to your help, as well as the save files and logs you provided, we were finally able to identify and fix this frustrating issue.
We thought we had fixed it in the previous patch, but it turned out there were multiple underlying issues causing the problem, which is why it kept happening.
If you're enjoying the game, please consider leaving a review on Steam. Thanks!
Patch 1.1.6 is now live!
Fixed that while playing with controller you could give the Dog companion commands that were not unlocked yet.
Fixed that while playing with controller you could check the Dog companion storage while not being in range of the dog.
Fixed a regression introduced in patch 1.1.5 which caused environment states, like the broken bridges, to not properly sync at the start when a player joins another session.
Patch 1.1.5 is now live!
Fixed an issue where a re-joining player could lose either their customization, inventory items, tools, or upgrades, or a combination of those, when they had a problem connecting to the server.
Fixed syncing of picking up a carrot on a plate in multiplayer.
Fixed that a red flower plant would show as a cactus plant when the save game was loaded.
Fixed that players could shortly show an animation of running while interacting with something (if the player would run towards the interaction and immediately interact).
Both carrots on plates and cups of coffee under coffee machines now respawn after a while.

topNew: Both carrots on plates and cups of coffee under coffee machines now respawn after a while.

items.text: Patch 1.1.4 is now live!
Fainting while fishing does not lead to a buggy state anymore.
Fixed a couple of fishing spots where you could fish on land.
Sound of airplanes is properly paused in pause menu (single player).
We cooked up some fantastic additions for Outbound that we're happy to share with you today!
This is a larger content update that introduces Fishing as the main feature, along with new buildable items such as fish tanks, stairs, and doors to expand your base-building options.
Added Fishing!
Added 3 Fishing Rods to obtain and craft, each required to fish in different areas.
Fishing Rods can be obtained from newly added Download terminals.
Added a new fisherman's hut to explore in the first biome.
Added a new fisherman's hut to explore in the second biome.
Added a new fisherman's cabin to explore in the forth biome.
All lakes and rivers, as well as the sea now contain fish that can be caught.
Added 32 collectible fish across all four biomes.
Added 4 pieces of Junk that are sometimes caught instead of a fish, that provide additional Litter or Bottle Caps.
Added a new Journal page to track the fish you've caught.
Each caught fish has a star-rating between 0 and 5. The highest caught star-rating will be logged in your journal.
Caught fish can be put into Fish Tanks that you can add to your homes.
Please note that we decided fish will not serve as a source of nutrition. Instead, they are intended as collectible and decorative elements for your homes.
Added 1 more fishing-related painting to collect.
Added 4 buildable Fish Tanks that can serve as habitats for your caught fish.
Added 6 buildable Stairs that can be used to create multi-level homes in addition to ladders (some of those need to be researched).
Added 4 buildable Doors that can be used to create rooms within your home. Doors can be opened and closed.
Some improvements to RAM consumption.
Bamboo shelf counter - fixed targeting of placed items and added more slots to place.
Airplanes can be heard from further distance now.
Your dog companion now keeps proper track of not putting more items in its storage while searching for new items.

notes.title: How to get your fishing rod

items.text: You can play with your existing save file, or start a new journey - whatever you prefer! The first fishing rod is available on Map 1 at the fishing hut near the lake with the pier in the first biome. This will also provide you with your first couple of buildable fish tanks. Following fishing rods and fish tanks can be acquired on Map 2 and 4!
A note regarding achievements: We decided not to add any new achievements to Outbound, as we want players who have already completed all achievements to retain the completionist status.

Please note that we are constantly improving Outbound, and there's much more to come. We will continue releasing smaller patches with bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements between major content updates.
We hope you're enjoying the additions and improvements we've been bringing to Outbound. Thank you for playing and for being part of the journey! :)

notes.title: Regarding the update size of this patch.

items.text: Some of you may have noticed that, despite containing relatively few changes, this patch requires a fairly large download (approximately 3 GB). This is due to a number of behind-the-scenes optimizations, as well as groundwork being laid for a larger upcoming update. We apologize for any confusion and appreciate your understanding.

notes.title: More customization options for all wooden items!

items.text: Based on your feedback, we’ve added many new colors to the wood customization options. You can now make your home shine in your favourite color! :)
We’ve heard your feedback about ladders and made major improvements to how they work.

First, we’ve added a new way to climb ladders: you can now interact with them to snap directly onto the ladder. This is especially useful when climbing from above. Previously, getting onto a ladder from the top was difficult and often nearly impossible.
You can still simply walk toward a ladder to start climbing. Since many players are already familiar with this behavior, we decided to keep it unchanged.
We’ve also improved ladder snapping detection overall, especially when stepping off ladders, making movement feel much smoother and more reliable.

Previously, movement direction was determined by your look angle. Looking upward meant moving forward would take you up, while looking downward meant moving forward would take you down. We’ve now added a setting that lets you choose your preferred behavior, including an option where moving forward always means up and moving backward always means down.
We added ladder animations for multiplayer!
We hope you’re enjoying the additions and improvements we’ve been bringing to Outbound. Thank you for playing and for being part of the journey! :)

topNew: It is now also possible to click to snap onto a ladder.
Ladders can also be used from above.

Bugfixes

notes.title: Download Vouchers & Bottle Cap Wallet Patch

items.text: Patch 1.0.10 just went online!
Added Download Voucher & Bottle Cap 'Wallet' (See below).
Download Vouchers and Bottle Caps do not weight anything anymore.
Download Vouchers and Bottle Caps are not deposited anymore.
Overall improvement of vehicle syncing in multiplayer, among others against a specific case of sometimes vehicles slowly floating in the air over a long time.
Fixed an issue with building crop plots and other larger items on top of the metal small side tables.
Fixed an issue where the dog's position did not follow the elevator position properly.
Fixed a number of translations.

We've heard a lot of feedback about the download vouchers and bottle caps having weight and not automatically being locked in your backpack. So we decided to make a 'wallet' for such special items with two separate inventory slots!

Download vouchers and bottle caps don't have any weight anymore, so you can take as many with you as you want. You also don't have to lock these items in your storage, as they do not get deposited anymore. You can still drop the items for your friends to use in multiplayer.
We hope that you will like the balancing changes and improvements we are introducing to Outbound! We are happy to hear your feedback and will incorporate that in future patches.

items.text: Patch 1.0.9 just went online!
(Likely) fixed that sometimes there were no downloads in a download terminal, which was essentially soft-locking.
If an issue with downloads happens, you can now send your save and log files to us with a single button click, which helps us investigating.
Fixed that vehicle lights sometimes were turned on automatically at the wrong time of day.
Fixed Ring-a-Ding-Ding! achievement (collect 100 bottle caps) in multiplayer.
Fixed Cap 'n Snaps map legend properly showing them.
Fixed that the paintings Red Ridge Airstrip and Golden Shores looked identical.
Fixed an issue with crop plots in multiplayer, sometimes preventing them from being harvested.
Translated some unlocalized texts.
Smaller multiplayer stability fixes.
Doubled the amount of clay received from clay deposits.
We hope that you will like the balancing changes and improvements we are introducing to Outbound! We are happy to hear your feedback and will incorporate that in future patches.

Patch 1.0.8 just went online! Based on player feedback, we are introducing a couple of balancing changes in this patch, mainly targeting the slow movement, running at night, and lumber / plank, fiber, and Red Ore shortages. This is only a start and we will introduce more improvements in future patches.
You can now sprint at night.
Increased sprinting speed by 15%.
Increased stamina regain (regain after empty stamina bar) by 150%.
Removed Homing Boots (temporary sprint at night), because they don't serve a purpose anymore, now that you can sprint at night.
Recipe Everwood Plank changed from requiring 2 Everwood to now requiring only 1 (ratio 1:1).
Recipe Silverbark Plank changed from requiring 2 Silverbark Wood to now requiring only 1 (ratio 1:1).
Recipe Redwood Plank changed from requiring 2 Redwood to now requiring only 1 (ratio 1:1).
Recipe Blossomwood Plank changed from requiring 2 Blossomwood to now requiring only 1 (ratio 1:1).
Map 1: Bridge at the Sunbeam Acres Farm now only requires 20 Everwood Planks to repair, instead of 30.
Increased the amount of Everwood lumber and Fiber in Map 1.
Increased the amount of Durafiber in Map 2.
Doubled the amount of Red Ore in Map 3.
Added sorting and text search to Backpack inventory.
Map: Improved legend, added counters of collected / interacted things. Especially handy to check how many Signal Towers / Terminals are left on a map.
Connections between maps are now always uncovered by default.
Connections between maps have clearer map icons now.
Multiplayer highlighting / pinging can now be remapped (default: middle mouse button / left stick press).
Dog companion now always spawns next to you when loading a game. This helps with dogs that are stuck (we will also work on preventing that).
Added a setting to turn off auto-centering of the third-person vehicle camera.
Fixed dog companion always barking when leaving the vehicle.
Fixed Cap 'n Snaps not showing on map after a transition between biomes.
Achievement Certified Researcher now properly includes the research stations in the 4th dome as well.
We hope that you will like the balancing changes and improvements we are introducing to Outbound! We are happy to hear your feedback and will incorporate that in future patches.

topNew: Added sorting and text search to Backpack inventory.
Connections between maps are now always uncovered by default.
Connections between maps have clearer map icons now.

items.text: Patch 1.0.7 just went online!
Fixed download signals not appearing anymore since patch 1.0.6.
Hello travellers!

It's only been a couple days since launch but it feels like so long has passed! We know there's been a few bumps in the road but, we’re thrilled to see how many players are playing and enjoying Outbound. Your support and your feedback has been a genuine motivation for us to continue improving Outbound and so, from all of the team at Square Glade Games we want to say a heartfelt "Thank You" to our players and community - we've read your feedback in discussion threads, reviews and Discord and we know there is a strong desire to see Outbound flourish through more content and features to be added.
We’re proud to say that Outbound 1.0 is just the beginning. We have ambitious plans for the game and we'll continue to improve and expand thanks to your feedback!

notes.title: Here is our current roadmap for Outbound 2026

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/32b79ff9325f59f6ee21bdb611b4ba73bea76fea.png"]

We already have some of the roadmap content in the making and are able to show you a preview of what is yet to come! With the 1.1 update, which is planned for the summer, we will add fishing and fish tanks to the game!

You will be able to fish on different spots in the world and catch a variety of fish. Fish will be tracked in your journal as you catch/collect them. Depending on the size of the fish, they will also have a star rating!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/9554fb236c8db866369d359b76b7b9aff22fc9e7.png"]
After you've caught a fish, you can put it into a fish tank as a decorative piece! Please note, as with other animals, that we do not intend to use them as food source. They are purely decorative! :)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/e62b295f12556f76ac391af2178a2156f3d3d502.png"]
We already released several patches with lots of quality of life improvements, bug fixes and did lots of general stability improvements.

And today, patch 1.0.6 goes live!
We've just added another patch that addressed a number of issues flagged by players.
Added manual light control over vehicle lights (see below).
Added filter and search functionality to storage (see below).
Controller: When selecting a save game, you can just press (A) to jump to the load button, without needing to go through the whole list of save games anymore.

After interacting with all signal towers in a biome, the frequency of signals to appear is much higher now.

Fixed dog companion material depositing could lead to a buggy state of the storage UI.
Fixed flash light icon showing while driving.
Fixed flash light being usable while in a UI.
Multiplayer: Fixed a bug that bee hives or water catchers sometimes became unusable.

notes.title: Added: Full control over vehicle lights

items.text: We’ve heard that many of you want to be able to turn off your vehicle lights at night. Good news! You can now fully control your vehicle’s lights and turn them on or off whenever you want!
By default, the lights automatically turn on at dusk once per day, but you can disable this in the settings if you prefer full manual control.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/d369b154200a0876f97b573d2faf0226eb993ada.gif"]
By popular request: We added sorting and searching functionality to the vehicle (and dog companion) storage. You can now:
Sort alphabetically.
Sort by stack size.
Show all food first.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/3796af96e00d2e3ad9f1b346758d2e00fac1fde1.gif"]

Game dev is a marathon not a sprint. We know we wouldn't be able to make these fixes without your support. Thank you once again for all of your feedback and for helping us make Outbound a better game.
We’re excited to share more on our future plans with you very soon!
See you on the trail!
Patch 1.0.5 just went online!

We added a highly requested quality-of-life feature: when you deposit resources into your vehicle and your trusty companion is nearby, they will automatically deposit the contents of their pouch into the vehicle as well. This means you no longer have to remove materials from their pouch one by one just to store them.

We added the possibility to select a region when creating multiplayer sessions. Some players indicated that this feature might help fixing connection problems in their region. If you are experiencing issues with disconnects, it might be worth trying to connect to a different region.
You also have the possibility to select the region "Automatic", which will always select the closest server near you. This is important to know, especially when using a VPN client.
This also can help networking stability when playing with a friend on the other side of the world, selecting their region instead of using the automatic selection.
Happy to hear if this solves networking issues for some of you!

releases.displayName: Outbound Demo Update: Thank You All!

items.text: Hey everyone! 👋
We just wanted to take a moment to share a quick update now that the Outbound demo has been out for two days, and wow, we are absolutely blown away!

First off, thank you. We’ve already received so many warm and positive messages from players who’ve taken the time to try the demo. It’s been incredibly motivating to read your thoughts and see how much joy you're finding in building your homes on wheels, exploring the world, and crafting!
And to some of you - we loved seeing you break the game. Shout out to everyone who managed to climb to the PEAK of the mountains 😹

At the moment the demo’s overall rating on Steam is sitting at about 81% positive over 350 reviews! This response genuinely makes us so grateful, thank you for taking the time to share your thoughts! But beyond sheer numbers, what matters most to us is how you feel when you play, and those kinds of messages have truly made our day.

We’ve also received a lot of thoughtful, constructive feedback, and we’re listening. This early stage is a hugely important moment for us to refine how Outbound feels and reads to new players. One of the first changes we’ve made based on your input is updating the Steam store text to better reflect the heart of what Outbound is:

notes.title: ➡️ It’s a cozy game first and foremost,

items.text: meant to be a gentle, calm, and stress-free experience. There’s no rush, no threats, and no survival pressure, just freedom, exploration, and slow-paced creativity. Of course, although we’re fans of more demanding survival games ourselves, Outbound is for all the players out there that enjoy no-pressure experience. We want that message to come through the moment someone first opens the store page. Because of this, you may notice changes incoming in the game’s description!

We’ve had a chance to see Raptor trying something really cool in his stream on Tuesday: to cover a campfire with the side door while it's raining! We decided that that should indeed work! And so, here is a few patch notes we’ve implemented to the demo:
You can now cover a campfire with the horizontal doors of your vehicle OR with your base building floors and roofs!
We’ve fixed updating material counts on tasks if another player puts materials into the vehicle.
We’ve improved the building UI!

We’re digging into all of your feedback and taking notes! Thank you for hopping into the demo, building your dream vans, and helping us make Outbound something truly special. We hope you have a great Next Fest, see you soon! 🚐❤️

Hey, Travellers!
We have some news that still doesn’t quite feel real: Outbound just crossed a million wishlists.

That’s a number none of us expected, and yet here we are. We know wishlist numbers are just one part of the journey. This milestone feels like an incredible checkpoint. Thank you for every single wishlist, share, screenshot you posted, and piece of feedback you sent-it all adds up, more than you might know.

We have been busy at work on the game, and there is plenty to share with you, as we are fast approaching the end of the year, and entering 2026 - the year of the release. So, without further ado… here’s what we’ve been up to!
We’re excited to share that our closed Beta has started on October 15th, available to Kickstarter Beta tier backers!

notes.title: What is part of the Beta?

items.text: Everything that was part of the Alpha, is also part of the Beta -> Read our Alpha update!

The Beta contains the first two playable biomes and most of the features that we expect to be in the full game. We will use the Beta to further iron out bugs and to overall shape and polish the game based on player feedback.

The Coast combines tropical shores with rocky cliffs and lush forests. Gigantic redwood trees rise from the ground just beyond the sand, while palm trees cluster on the sandy beaches where the scent of fresh fruit and the salty sea welcomes you. The old lighthouse atop the coastal cliffs serves as a vital landmark for ships navigating the nearby traffic routes. Welcome to the Coast!

We’ve added the beloved canine companion to the game! Your loyal dog responds to your commands and assists you throughout your journey by fetching items, carrying supplies, and even bringing them back to your vehicle. And of course, your furry friend rides along with you, too!

Based on feedback during the Alpha, we’ve expanded exploration across all landmarks! Be sure to search carefully! Key items are hidden within each landmark. Collect them all to unlock the Download Terminal and access new blueprint downloads!

We’ve added a Journal to help you keep track of your journey and discover what you might have missed. You'll record materials, food items, crafting workstations, landmarks, collectibles, and even statistics about your adventure.

Since this was a highly requested feature from our Alpha testers, we’ve added the ability to drive at night! On top of that, we’ve introduced a new upgrade, the Homing Boots, which help you return to your vehicle more quickly after dark.
Outbound is still in development, therefore a couple of features are still missing, but are planned for the rest of the development time:
Biome 3 and 4
Character customization
Fishing
Bee keeping
More vehicle options to choose from
Language support
Kickstarter rewards
Console ports
More settings and accessibility options
More materials, building pieces, workstations, etc.

We’re excited to share an updated version of our Kickstarter roadmap! The project remains right on track. As promised, the Beta rolled out in the second half of 2025! We’ve also refined the 1.0 release window, updating it from “First half of 2026” to Q2 2026 for more clarity (should also be visible on the Steam store page now).
Thank you for being part of this journey and we are very much looking forward to your feedback on the Beta!
